name: Symbol
what_it_does: Opens a gallery of recently used symbols plus More Symbols… (the full character map) to insert characters not on the keyboard.
behavior: Opens Symbol (dropdown). Contents (23 controls): Color swatches, Symbol, Euro Sign, Pound Sign, Yen Sign, Copyright Sign, Registered Sign, Trade Mark Sign, Plus-Minus Sign, Not Equal To, Less-Than Or Equal To, Greater-Than Or Equal To, Division Sign, Multiplication Sign, Infinity, Micro Sign. [flyout of subfeature:symbol-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as an omega symbol, labelled 'Symbol', with a chevron.
